title: Localization descent for the derived signed shift equation
statement:
theorem derived_shift_descent {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} X.ProEt] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} Y.ProEt] (s : Option ℕ)
    (SX : Closed l E X s) (SY : Closed l E Y s)
    (TX : Models l E X s SX) (TY : Models l E Y s SY)
    (c : Comparison l E g s SX SY TX TY)
    (hmodel : ∀ (P I : K l E Y s) (hI : I.IsKInjective) (a b : ℤ),
      derivedShiftEquation l E g s SX SY TX TY c
        ((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj P)
        ((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj I) a b) :
    ∀ (M N : podReindexingDerived l E Y s) (a b : ℤ),
      derivedShiftEquation l E g s SX SY TX TY c M N a b

proof.text: Resolve arbitrary derived targets by K-injective complexes and represent sources by localized complexes. Naturality of the comparison and the factorization equations in `Comparison.derived_model` transport the representative equality; cancel the resolution isomorphisms and use essential surjectivity of localization.
